# WarmWake

> WarmWake is a mobile alarm app that starts the day with a voice message that the user recorded earlier.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://warmwake.donminzzi.kr/): Product overview and app download links.
- [Privacy](https://warmwake.donminzzi.kr/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://warmwake.donminzzi.kr/terms): Service terms.
- [Sitemap](https://warmwake.donminzzi.kr/sitemap.xml): Index of public pages.

## App downloads

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758120543)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kr.mirae.app)

## Agent guidance

- Public marketing and policy content is available without authentication.
- `/alarm/*` routes redirect users to an app store and do not contain indexable content.
- This site does not publish a public API, authentication service, MCP server, or payment endpoint.
